problem_type: Legacy migration assigns shot identities to non-shot views
symptom: A new shot table receives shotIndex1 and pushes the first generated shot to mirror label2.
direct_cause: The old migration used categoryId alone to assign sorted indexes to every node including tables and text.
class_root: Migration bypassed the canonical shot-number predicate and rewrote existing persistent identities.
affected_population: New shot tables, text views and existing numbered shots in projects that run the legacy migration
internal_only_reason: The invariant is enforced by the existing in-process canvasGestureContext and canvasWriteBoundary; no external API or dependency behavior changed.
invariants: Only isShotNumberedNode candidates receive an index; existing valid shot indexes remain unchanged.
generality_proof: Both migration admission and assignment use the same existing shotNumbering boundary as factory creation and normal hydration.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Delegate missing shot numbering to the canonical backfill.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Currently category shots with no index incorrectly requests migration forever for non-shot views.
Category-only sorted assignment overwrites all IDs; replace with backfillShotIndexes.

recurrence.reason: Every non-shot view within shots and any existing nonsequential shot identity can trigger the same wrong renumbering.
same_class_scan: projectV51ToV60Migration recordNeeds and step3 independently inspected
rendererNodeFactoryDeps, shotNumbering and projectPersistenceService already use canonical predicate/backfill

prevention.invariant: Only isShotNumberedNode candidates receive an index; existing valid shot indexes remain unchanged.
prevention.failure_mode: Existing canWrite/pending proposal guards still reject foreign or stale writes.
prevention.strategy: Reuse isShotNumberedNode for admission and backfillShotIndexes for assignment; remove the parallel category-only renumberer.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate implementation exists; the two unscoped calls are replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal mutation ownership, no third-party lifecycle involved.

migration: Legacy missing eligible shot indexes use existing deterministic backfill; already numbered image identities remain unchanged. No guessing original numbers for data already damaged by earlier runs.
residual_risks: Previously persisted wrong shot numbers cannot safely be inferred or rewritten automatically.
